label: 5th generation: annual limit on non-severe non-covered treatment
unit: KRW per year, non-severe non-covered rider
appliesTo: Holders of 5th generation policies claiming non-covered treatment outside the severe categories
why: The number that shows what the 2026 reform actually did. Severe non-covered treatment — cancer, cerebrovascular and cardiac disease, rare and intractable conditions — is handled in its own rider, while everything else sits under this ceiling with a high excess and several common therapies excluded outright. Anyone choosing between an existing policy and a new one is really choosing between two different treatments of this category.

history.source: Financial Services Commission — 5th generation indemnity health insurance
history.note: Annual cover under the non-severe non-covered rider. Manual therapy, extracorporeal shockwave, prolotherapy and certain non-covered injections are among the treatments excluded from this rider. The severe non-covered rider, tied to the health insurance special-calculation categories, is separate and more generous.
